Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
changes.evidence: In Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, the Earth-838 Mordo is the Sorcerer Supreme and master of the New York Sanctum: he walks out of the Sanctum to greet Strange, and Strange accuses him of killing Supreme Strange to get the Sanctum and become Sorcerer Supreme before joining the Illuminati. That puts him in the order of sorcerers (the Masters of the Mystic Arts, the name the dataset already uses), and he held that role before he took the Illuminati seat. The record leaves the order out.

In X-Men '97 S2 (the record's episode 14 step, Marvel Database's Season 2 episode 3), Candra is a member of the pharaoh Rama-Tut's court in 3000 B.C. (the dataset files Rama-Tut's regime as 'Ancient Egypt'). When Apocalypse destroys the city, Rama-Tut flees in his time machine and leaves her behind, so his court ends for her. The record leaves that past group out. The left list should also get "X-Men '97 S2".
